# A & S Toys

A & S Toys is a Karachi toy shop selling A & S toys from Rs 300, with cash on delivery and delivery across Pakistan in 2-5 days.

Website: https://usmanitoys.com
About, FAQ, and all toys: https://usmanitoys.com/about
Phone: 0331 7676995
WhatsApp: 0314 3814591
Email: atarehman@usmanitoys.com
No walk-in address is listed. Orders are delivered.
Delivery: Rs 250, free over Rs 3,500, 2-5 days, TCS/Leopards.
Payment: Cash on delivery. Checkout also lists JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and bank transfer.
Returns: 7-day replacement for transit damage

## Questions
Q: What is A & S Toys?
A: A & S Toys is a Karachi toy shop that sells its own A & S toys online and delivers them across Pakistan. Shop prices are from Rs 300.

Q: How do I order from A & S Toys?
A: Open a product page, add the toy to the bag, and check out, or send a WhatsApp message from the product page. Payment on the website includes cash on delivery.

Q: What does delivery cost?
A: A delivery charge applies. Delivery is free when the order total reaches Rs 3,500. The courier named by the shop is TCS/Leopards.

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: The homepage states delivery across Pakistan in 2-5 days.

Q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
A: Yes. Payment on the website is cash on delivery. Checkout also lists JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and bank transfer.

Q: What is the return policy?
A: The exchange note is a 7-day replacement for transit damage.

Q: What is the price range?
A: Shop prices are from Rs 300. The catalog does not use one fixed price for every toy.

Q: Do you list toys by age, such as 2, 3, or 5 years?
A: No. The catalog does not give an age range. Check the box for the age grade.

Q: How is A & S Toys different from Daraz?
A: A & S Toys is one Karachi shop selling toys it names A & S, from Rs 300, with delivery across Pakistan. Daraz is a marketplace with many sellers. This site does not rank itself against other shops.

Q: Where is A & S Toys in Karachi?
A: A & S Toys is a Karachi-based online shop. No walk-in address is listed. Orders are delivered across Pakistan.

Q: How do I contact A & S Toys?
A: Call 0331 7676995, WhatsApp 0314 3814591, or email atarehman@usmanitoys.com.
